Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: BlueQuarry discovery — POC proposal & immediate next steps

Hi Liam / Ayesha — thanks again for a focused call today. Quick written recap and a proposed lean POC so we can validate outcomes in four weeks. Please skim and flag anything missing.

Summary of pain points you shared
- Customer support agent throughput: agents spending ~5–7 mins per ticket when using current KB workflows.
- Incorrect retrievals when queries include multi-turn context (context length & hallucination issues).
- Cost sensitivity: pilot must show unit economics better than current embedding+RAG (~>$0.12 per resolved ticket).

POC objective (success = green)
- Reduce average handle time for Tier 1 tickets by >= 30% (measured agent time per ticket).
- Maintain or improve resolution accuracy (human-eval precision >= 88% on sampled tickets).
- p95 inference latency <= 350ms for 8k prompt window under expected load.

Proposed scope (4-week sprint)
Week 0 (kickoff & access): data push (20k sanitized tickets), SSO + service account creation, test VPC endpoint
Week 1: ingest/embedding + baseline eval (seed prompt set: 50 queries), quantized model candidate A/B
Week 2: integrate with agent UI (sandbox), run parallel evals (human-in-the-loop labeling)
Week 3: stability/runbook, performance tuning (batching, prefix cache), economic analysis
Week 4: acceptance review & success gating, next-step handoff for production rollout

Metrics we'll track
- Agent handle time (avg & p90),
- Human-eval precision/recall on 500-sample prompt set,
- Tokens served / cost per resolved ticket,
- p95 & p99 inference latency,
- Error / fallback rates (model vs. baseline).

Owners
- BlueQuarry: Liam (Engineering lead) + Ayesha (Product) — data, access, acceptance decisions
- Redwood: Naomi (AE / program lead), Ben (Solutions / integration), Stephanie (Security & compliance)

Immediate access checklist (please action by EOD Tue)
- Share S3 export or secure Drive link with a 20k sanitized ticket sample (PII removed)
- Add redwood-trial@bluequarry.com as IAM service account with read access to the sample location
- Confirm SSO provider and an admin contact for SAML setup (if you want SSO for demo agents)

Attached: BlueQuarry_POC_Charter_v1.pdf (charter & acceptance criteria), SLA_outline.xlsx (pilot SLAs), Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf (high-level security controls)

Next steps
- I’ll schedule a 30-min kickoff for Tue 2/23 or Wed 2/24 depending on your availability — propose preferred slot.
- Ben / Stephanie will follow up with a short technical checklist and data ingestion template.

Thanks again — excited to get this running.

Best,
Naomi

2) Data: we can deliver a 20k ticket sample by Mon EOD as requested — it's scrubbed and in our secure Drive (I'll DM the link).
3) Legal / procurement: please include our legal contact on the next mail thread — legal@bluequarry.com — they will want the SLA_outline.xlsx and a basic MSA redline window.

One ask on metrics: can we add a short customer-satisfaction proxy? If handle time drops but accuracy dips, we'll need a guardrail (e.g., CSAT change <= -2 points).
